description: A simple and trivial FastCGI server implementation used for unit testing, which processes a single FastCGI request at a time, with hard-coded responses based on query string parameters. It includes socket setup, request parsing, and response generation functions.

methods.name: int sock_nb_set(SOCKET fd,unsigned int nb)
methods.description: Sets non-blocking mode on a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: void fcgi_header(FCGI_Header * const header,const unsigned char type,const int request_id,const int contentLength,const unsigned char paddingLength)
void fcgi_unknown_type_rec(FCGI_UnknownTypeRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const unsigned char type)
methods.description: Creates a record for an unknown FastCGI record type.

methods.name: void fcgi_end_request_rec(FCGI_EndRequestRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const uint32_t appStatus,const unsigned char protocolStatus)
methods.description: Creates an EndRequest record for FastCGI.

methods.name: int fcgi_puts(const int req_id,const char * const str,size_t len,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Sends a string response via FastCGI stdout records.

methods.name: const char * fcgi_getenv(const unsigned char * const r,const uint32_t rlen,const char * const name,int nlen,int * len)
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from FastCGI request data.

methods.name: int fcgi_process_params(FILE * const stream,int req_id,int role,unsigned char * const r,uint32_t rlen)
methods.description: Processes FastCGI parameters and generates corresponding responses based on query string values.

methods.name: int fcgi_dispatch_packet(FILE * stream,ssize_t offset,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Dispatches a FastCGI packet based on its type.

methods.name: ssize_t fcgi_recv_packet(FILE * const stream,ssize_t sz)
methods.description: Receives and processes incoming FastCGI packets from a stream.

methods.name: int fcgi_recv(const SOCKET fd,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, parses FastCGI packets, and handles request lifecycle.

methods.name: int main(void)
methods.description: Main server loop that sets up listening socket, accepts connections, and processes requests.
